mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 260.0 indicates persistent inflationary pressures that trigger immediate market concern about policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.5%) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signal a deteriorating economic cycle, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both UNRATE > 6.5% and HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO > 103.0) indicates robust supply-side economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 103.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS > 140,000 thousand) signals strong consumer demand and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 140,000 thousand, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 260.0 indicates persistent inflationary pressures that prompt immediate market concern, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 260.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 18500) and rising industrial production (INDPRO > 103.0) indicate a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 > 18500 and INDPRO > 103.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
